# has segment

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:hasSegment`](gmeow-hasSegment.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasSegment>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/documents`](../../slices/documents.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Relates a whole (work, release, installment, or another segment) to a structural part. Non-functional: a work may have many segments. Inverse of [`gmeow:segmentOf`](gmeow-segmentOf.md).

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; `?` -> [`gmeow:ContentSegment`](../classes/gmeow-ContentSegment.md)
**Sub-property of:** [`gmeow:hasPart`](gmeow-hasPart.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:hasSegment`](gmeow-hasSegment.md) from `?` to [`gmeow:ContentSegment`](../classes/gmeow-ContentSegment.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:hasPart`](gmeow-hasPart.md), [`gmeow:ContentSegment`](../classes/gmeow-ContentSegment.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to attach a structural [`gmeow:ContentSegment`](../classes/gmeow-ContentSegment.md) to its containing whole from the whole's side — a work, release, installment, or parent segment to its chapters/scenes; non-functional.

### Avoid when

- Avoid it for non-structural membership (a feed's items ride the generic [`gmeow:hasPart`](gmeow-hasPart.md)) and prefer asserting [`gmeow:segmentOf`](gmeow-segmentOf.md), reading [`gmeow:hasSegment`](gmeow-hasSegment.md) as its inverse, except in whole-rooted projections.

### How to use

- Attach each [`gmeow:ContentSegment`](../classes/gmeow-ContentSegment.md) to its whole; [`gmeow:hasSegment`](gmeow-hasSegment.md) specializes [`gmeow:hasPart`](gmeow-hasPart.md) so generic part queries still see it, and [`gmeow:segmentOf`](gmeow-segmentOf.md) is its transitive inverse.

### Examples

- ex:novel [`gmeow:hasSegment`](gmeow-hasSegment.md) ex:chapter1, ex:chapter2.
